item.title: IN PHOTOS | Satellite images of damage in Iran, Gulf nations
item.summary: Satellite images show the damage to naval bases, airports and other key facilities inside Iran since the U.S.-Israel attacks began Feb. 28, as well as damage from Iran's retaliatory strikes on Persian Gulf neighbours.

item.title: IN PHOTOS | Day 10: U.S.-Israel war with Iran
item.summary: Iran marked the naming of Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei to replace his father as its supreme leader with a new barrage of missiles against Israel and Persian Gulf nations on Monday, as the Mideast war sent oil prices soaring.

item.title: What we know about Iran's new supreme leader, Mojtaba Khamenei
item.summary: Iran on Monday named Mojtaba Khamenei to succeed his father, Ali Khamenei, as supreme leader, signalling that hardliners remain firmly in charge in Tehran more than a week ‌into its conflict with the United States and Israel.

item.title: At least 42 people killed in Kenya floods
item.summary: The death toll from heavy rains and flooding in Kenya's capital, Nairobi, and elsewhere has nearly doubled to 42, the government said ‌in a statement issued late on Sunday.

item.title: Woman arrested following gunshots fired near Rihanna's L.A. home
